interface.title: zpcr//web — Bio-Rad CFX qPCR .zpcr viewer
interface.stage_of_work: Post-run data inspection and QC of thermocycler output (plus light plate-layout editing and an optional instrument-control emulator)
interface.what_it_is_for: Open Bio-Rad CFX (.zpcr/.pcrd/.plt.csv) or Biomeme (.bmrun) run files in the browser and look at amplification and melt curves, Cq/Tm values, the thermal protocol as run, the plate layout, optical reference and calibration data, and the raw archive entries.

data.note: I opened the bundled sample 20260726_S183-S185_RVP.zpcr with 'Load an example file'. I ticked 20260726_S183-S185_RVP.pcrd and 20190516_122922_CT019138_SHORT_QUALIF.zpcr in the Files tab's samples folder. I uploaded the test file biomeme-2025-10-15-melt.bmrun through load file → Upload…. The .pcrd stayed locked behind a CFX password prompt.

features.name: Amplification curve plot with baseline/scale modes
features.general: Plot per-sample signal over cycles, switch between raw and baseline-subtracted values, show the fitted baseline, and switch between linear and log axes
features.specific: Curves chart: Values Relative (ΔRFU) / Absolute (RFU), Draw baseline toggle, Scale Linear / Log, Cq circles on each curve
steps: toggle Draw baseline to see the fitted baseline and its window ticks
serves_tasks: Switch between baseline-subtracted and raw signal, and linear and log axes
Plot amplification curves per sample position and detection channel

features.name: Per-channel threshold editor driving Cq
features.general: Set a detection threshold automatically (as a multiple of noise) or by hand per detection channel; crossing points recompute on the plot and in the table
features.specific: Threshold panel: Auto threshold slider (20× noise), FAM/Tex 615/Cy5 RFU spinboxes with per-dye reset; Cq markers move to the new threshold
steps: drag the auto-threshold multiplier or type an RFU value for one dye
serves_tasks: Set the detection threshold and see quantification cycles update
Read per-well quantification values in a sortable table and export them

click wells (or Unk/NTC/Pos) to include or exclude them

Plot amplification curves per sample position and detection channel

features.name: Sortable result table with CSV export
features.general: Switch the chart to a per-sample table of fitted baseline, threshold, crossing cycle and end-point signal; sort any column and download it
features.specific: View: Table (Well, Sample, Type, Fluor, Target, Baseline, Threshold, Cq with position bar, ΔRFU); CSV button writes *_analysis.csv or *_melt.csv
steps: click a column header such as CQ to sort
serves_tasks: Read per-well quantification values in a sortable table and export them
View melt curves and the derived melting temperatures

features.name: Thermal protocol listing + as-run temperature profile

screens_never_reached: Overview/Protocol/Curves/Plates/Reference/Calibration/Raw for 20260726_S183-S185_RVP.pcrd: all greyed out behind a 'Password required' banner asking for the CFX file password, which the app does not ship (screens/039.webp, screens/040.webp)
About page (zpcr//web logo button): not opened, to save actions
Reference and Calibration for the .bmrun: tabs disabled for Biomeme files (screens/046.webp)
Instrument 'Files on the instrument', 'Identity' and running a cloned experiment on the fake device: not explored
Incomplete-run banner on Overview and the matching file-tab marker: no cancelled or partial run was opened, so neither appeared
not_done: Compare the .pcrd file's CFX-reported Cq against the app's computed Cq: the .pcrd stayed locked behind the CFX password prompt, and I had no password to enter. The .zpcr table shows only the app's computed Cq.
Compare file-reported and app-computed baseline/Cq on the loaded .bmrun: its File ↔ Computed analysis-source toggle was never tried.

Confirm a run that 'stopped short': SHORT QUALIF showed 10 reads, which matches its protocol (2 + 8 passes), and I saw no explicit completed/incomplete marker. Other samples (SINGLE_STEP, GRADIENTTEST, Luna_noRT.pcrd) were not opened.

Fluorophore grouping view (colour-separated dyes, visible in screens/047.webp and screens/049.webp), the Samples and LED current panels, the Cq range slider, and the Show dark / Min/max band toggles (seen in screens/055.webp) were not tried.

Plate download/clone/replace, .plt.csv export/import, the Overview save/edit/copy buttons, writing or editing a thermal protocol, 'New experiment', and starting a cloned run on the simulated instrument were not tried.
Drag-and-drop loading, 'Add folder…' and sharing a view by link were not tried; I used the example button, sample checkboxes and Upload… instead.

The replay of t18/f12 is not_confirmed because the replayer ran out of actions before the Instrument tab; the explorer's screens/052.webp–054.webp show the connection and an accepted Open lid command.
